svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)

The top module is structural. HyperBus control and the PHY run on CLK-CORE (2 x CK); the AXI4 interface runs on CLK-AXI, the same clock as CLK-CORE or an asynchronous one behind the AXI crossing; APB4 is asynchronous on CLK-APB. DQ and RWDS cross the top boundary as separate input, output and active-high OE signals; the SoC pad wrapper maps them to the pads and provides the delay line of the read capture.
One structural top with APB4 CSR, AXI4 clock crossing, AXI4, HyperBus control and PHY children.
